name: hessian_grf_step2
purpose: TASKS 201 step 2 (the user, 12 Nov: 'doe stap 2 na optie 3, vóór S3'): the vibrational error of our analytic label Hessians from the missing XC grid response, measured against central differences of grid-response gradients (pyscf hessian/test/test_rks.py finite_diff; our blocked grid response, software ledger 57) on benzene (A_8448043181, 12 atoms) and B_0f06474656 (15 atoms, lowest B3LYP mode 9.5 cm-1 below its 9.8 cm-1 translation frequency), B3LYP and wB97X at the label grid (99,590) on pyscf 2.15.0

estimate.basis: per functional one SCF and analytic Hessian, then 6N displaced SCFs from the reference density with one grid-response gradient each: 72 points (benzene) and 90 (B_0f06474656) per functional; ≈ 15-30 s a point at (99,590) by the water test's scaling, not yet timed on these molecules

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the step at 8192 MB (CAP_MB; pyscf max_memory 4096); 12-15 atoms at 6-31G* hold well under it
